annotations.title: Ask the person for their images

description: For a picture the person has on their phone or computer and has not attached in the chat: gives a link where they upload it — their logo, photos, a signature scan; also when you see an attached picture but have no file of it. The person opens the link and picks the files; ask_for_images with the upload_id then returns each image's link (with its size and file name), for the document in render_pdf or update_document. The link also accepts the file’s bytes by POST. The link works for 24 hours and takes up to 50 images — photos straight from a phone or a camera too (HEIC, up to 40 MB each; brought to print size, 4096 px on the long side).

note.description: What to upload, shown to the person on the page, e.g. "Your company logo (PNG with a transparent background is best)". Only for a new link.

upload_id.description: The upload_id of a link you gave: what the person has uploaded to it so far.

name: ask_for_images

name.description: The file name on the person's device.
